notes.title: Small Patch 1.09
notes.notes: - Now you can discard filters to find creature bosses more easily.

notes.title: Small Patch 1.08
notes.notes:
- Now, Boss Creatures can either be fully visible or appear only as a shadow. Its tendency to reveal itself will depend on its visibility: a high tendency when fully visible and a low tendency when only its shadow is seen. However, since it is a tendency, both states are always possible.

- Interaction chances with map objects and equippable objects have been greatly increased based on the accumulated Aggressivity level and the level of generating events.

notes.title: Update 1.07
notes.notes:
We’re excited to share the latest updates and improvements in this patch! Your feedback has been invaluable in shaping the gameplay experience. Here’s what’s new:

[u][h3][u][b]Improvements[/b][/u][/h3][/u]

- Mouse is not laggy anymore.
- Enhanced creature and filter selection features.
- Fixed minor visual issues in the Ghost Journal.


[u][h2][b]Gameplay Adjustments[/b][/h2][/u]

- Purchasing is now restricted to inside the vehicle.
- Equip/Unequip functionality is only available inside the vehicle or outside, but not inside any building.
- Increased creature interactions with objects by 5-15% (depending on what kind).
- Reduced the chance of creatures turning off the power grid by 25%.
- Creatures now open doors 20% more often.

[u][h1][b]System Changes[/b][/h1][/u]

- Increased the minimum mouse sensitivity from 0 to 0.2.
- Resetting settings no longer displays the welcome UI.

notes.title: Fix's and aditions
notes.notes:
- Fixed Bugged EMF.
- Fixed a door in the wooden house.
- New mecanic: Now you can Exclude Creatures from the book.
- Added more descriptive information about NPC actions

At least 2 more update for this week.

notes.title: CO-OP Fixed
notes.notes:
- CO-OP got fixed
- For the East Coast Road Map (the open world map) now you will need lvl 2 or more to unlock the map.

notes.title: Small Update - Heavy Optimizations
notes.notes:
Optimizations for Low-End PCs Are on the Way!

We are achieving much more stable and higher frame rates on low-end machines in maps where the main ghost is hiding (Wooden House, Hospital, Abandoned School).

------Next Updates (End of This Week - Early Next Week):

-Further optimizations for the drivable vehicle to improve performance on low-end PCs.
-Introduction of the Garage.

notes.title: Early Patch's
notes.notes:
New Features:

Multi-Language Support: The game now supports multiple languages (currently in progress). Further refinements are coming soon.
Performance Enhancements:

Vehicle Optimization: Drastically reduced hardware usage when loading proximity assets and unnecessary physics calculations. Performance impact has been reduced by 20-40%, with additional improvements planned in upcoming updates.
Bug Fixes:

Chat System: Resolved a bug affecting chat functionality.

Note: This is just the first of several patches planned for this week, with more improvements and fixes on the way!

notes.title: Patch Notes: Stability Update
notes.notes:
Resolved several issues that were causing game crashes. The game should now run more smoothly without unexpected shutdowns.

Enhanced overall stability to improve the gameplay experience.

Thank you for your patience and support!
